verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a framework for building voice AI agents, so an in-product assistant is a fair question, but the evidence documents no built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The context-hub MCP server and the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md scaffolding only support external coding agents, and the agents developers build with Pipecat are developer building blocks rather than an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
